use: LOOK_MODEL (a member look from their photo, photo → anime)
prompt: Paint, do not photograph: turn the person in the attached photo into a painted illustration (brush strokes, painted skin and hair), never a retouched photo. Japanese anime-style semi-realistic illustration, modern Japanese anime key-visual look, clean fine line art, soft cel shading with gentle painterly light, Japanese character design, painted skin and hair — NOT a photograph, no photographic skin texture, no camera depth of field. Chest-up, centered, facing the viewer, a young person in their late teens or early twenties with a friendly, attractive face. A member of a mysterious secret society: an OVERSIZED, deep, mysterious hooded cloak, the big hood pulled up over the head and falling loosely around the shoulders, its edge casting a soft shadow, fine gold embroidery along the hood's edge. Round sunglasses with thin gold frames and pitch-black lenses with a faint golden reflection are always worn: the eyes are never visible. The mouth and the lower face are visible (no face mask, no scarf over the mouth). Modest clothes under the cloak with a high closed neckline, nothing revealing. Background: a dark night with soft golden glints and faint stars, softly blurred. Square image that works as a round profile icon (the face in the middle). Safe for children. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark. Base the character on the person in the attached photo: draw THEM as a semi-real painted portrait, keeping a clear likeness of their face shape, hairstyle and their own hair colour (painted and flattering). They wear round sunglasses with thin gold frames and pitch-black lenses, so their eyes are not visible. The ears of a cat come out through openings in the hood, the hood pulled up deep. Colours: the hood and cloak are blue, the lining is blue; the hair keeps the photo's own colour. Mood: calm; a gentle smile. They love music: show it as one small charm or accent they wear. Only this one person, never anyone else from the photo. Avoid: western cartoon, american comic style, 3D render, pixar style, photorealistic. Age: as they are, in their late teens or early twenties.

use: BATI_MODEL ({bati} dress-up, keeps the creature from its picture)
prompt: Edit the first picture: it is the same small magical partner creature called Bati — its look now, the reference to follow — and it must stay clearly the same creature: the same face, eyes, body shape, main colours, the tiny mark on its forehead and the framing, on a perfectly flat, solid pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background — one single even colour everywhere around it, also in the gaps — with no floor, no shadow, no light spill and no other objects; nothing on the character is that colour. Dress it up or change it following this wish: "魔法使いの帽子とマントを着せて" — new clothes, accessories, a hat, a small costume, a different art touch (watercolour, crayon, pixel art …) or a cute transformation (colours of a part, little wings, a tail tip, ears), never a different animal or a different character. Variation 1 of 4 (each of the four a clearly different take on the wish): a happy pose. No text, no letters. Rules for the look: it must not resemble any real, existing person; it must not resemble or copy any character, mascot, costume, logo or brand from an existing anime, game, film, book or company; nothing sexual or revealing; nothing violent (no weapons, blood or injuries). Cute and kids-friendly, never scary. IMPORTANT: it was born from the food "いちご", and a little of that food must stay visible somewhere on it in every look: a small hair ornament, a pattern or an item it holds that is clearly "いちご" (a red body with tiny yellow seeds, a green strawberry calyx worn as a hat) — small, not the main subject. If that would look unnatural, a small tattoo of "いちご" somewhere on its body.
